scope: Qualified-workspace production integration, offline checks, and a bounded Windows visual smoke test of the exact packaged runtime. Live Proton and full-campaign acceptance remain unverified.
remaining_reports: Full campaign and helicopter co-op acceptance
Proton co-op and local Spanish-voice import live acceptance

passed: Normal packaged Play launcher boots with visible, progressing intro video and Profile Select.
Profile Select, Main Menu, Options, scrolling Controls, Graphics, Audio and General render and navigate with mouse/keyboard.
Difficulty menu is visible, Rookie selects and returns to level selection.
Single Player Hope Street loads with scenery, actors, arms, weapon and HUD; click fires, ammo 15 to 14.
Pause, Objectives and Restart Mission confirmation are visible; No cancels restart. Quit confirmation returns to level select.
Co-op entry is available in the same main menu. Rotating T-Zero and Avenger previews, mouse character selection, both Ready and Continue work.
Hope Street co-op loads two distinct views with first-person weapons, other character visible, separate HUDs, black divider and device-specific prompts.
Player 1 firing changes only upper ammunition from 15 to 14; Player 2 stays at 15.
Player 1 pause opens Controls - Player 1 and Graphics - Player 1. World FOV slider applies 83 while Player 2 remains at 70; resumed upper view widens and lower view retains framing.
Quit co-op, return to main menu and deploy Canals in Single Player: full-frame scenery, effects, arms, weapon and HUD appear without split-screen.
not_verified: Physical Player 2 movement, firing and pause-menu ownership; tool has no controller input interface.
Live Linux/Proton gameplay or rendering; no usable live Proton environment on this host.
Full campaign, mission failure/death/revive paths, NPC progression and co-op aim accuracy (aim investigation remains on hold).
Audio quality and performance/frame pacing; another game occasionally took desktop focus.
Optional HD game textures were not installed in this isolated live test; separate installer check covers pack compatibility.
